tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List one workspace directory. Use next_offset for pagination; links and hidden files are excluded.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a bounded UTF-8 text slice plus its SHA-256. Read before editing; follow next_offset if needed.

tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Search literal text case-insensitively in workspace text files. Returns limited excerpts and truncation status.

tools.name: inspect_dataset
tools.description: Inspect a UTF-8 CSV: headers, record count, missing counts, bounded samples, and source SHA-256. Reject malformed CSV.

tools.name: validate_dataset
tools.description: Validate CSV against a rules JSON file. Returns schema errors, missing/type/label counts, duplicates, hashes, and up to 100 issues.

tools.name: find_duplicates
tools.description: Find exact duplicate CSV records using selected columns, or all columns when keys are omitted. Returns record numbers, not full rows.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Create a report/handoff text file, or overwrite only with its current SHA-256. Raw data, rules and cleaned outputs cannot be changed.

tools.name: str_replace
tools.description: Replace exactly one unique text match in writable notes/handoff/reports. Fails on ambiguous matches or stale file hash.

tools.name: create_clean_copy
tools.description: Apply an operator-supplied cleaning policy to a CSV. Requires current dataset/rules/policy hashes. Atomically creates a new run folder with cleaned.csv, excluded.json and report.json; never overwrites.

This actual second agent session received no earlier findings.
